title: Fuuka
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Loner Yuu Haruna moves to a new town and collides with Fuuka Akitsuki, a blunt girl who smashes his phone thinking he was photographing her underwear. They form a rock band, The Fallen Moon, with classmates while Yuu's childhood friend Koyuki, now a pop idol, re-enters his life. A sequel to Kouji Seo's Suzuka, it mixes band drama, a love triangle and fan service, and turns on a sudden death midway (to verify).
life_message: Chasing a shared dream with friends, and keeping promises to the people you love, gives life its meaning even through loss.
